parts.text: I see what's happening. In Agents.md, For each non-superviosr step, include the role as ChatGPT model and for every supervisor step include the role as Gemini model. Include the requirement that Gemini models are strictly forbidden from completing ChatGPT step. In the return schema specifically create a key for the role required and role forbidden and a key to input which role completed the step. And note that no role can simulate the response of either role. Moreover specify that roles are based on server information, must be checked using container or server inspection methods, and moreover the model executing within the js is always supervisor as ChatGPT does not execute within the JS but merely through GitHub.
